name: AI News Collector
headline: AI News Collector: Claude Code skill for News
short_description: This skill provides workflows and tools to gather the latest AI industry news from various platforms. It is designed for users interested in staying updated on AI trends and advancements.
author: yugasun

sections.overview:
AI News Collector is a news aggregation skill that gathers the latest AI industry news from various platforms. Designed for users who want to stay informed about AI trends and advancements, it provides workflows and tools to streamline news collection. This skill helps maintain awareness of developments across the AI sector without manual browsing of multiple sources.
Extract trending AI/ML repositories from GitHub.
Gather updates from key AI researchers on X (Twitter).
Summarize top AI headlines from tech news sources.
Compile collected AI news into a structured markdown digest.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
